observations.note: The explicit family x'=x-x^3+y, y'=-ky has identical endpoint outcomes for every nonempty persistent coordinate clamp, but slow/fast k produce opposite simultaneous-release endpoints. The supplied proof gives bounds and a staged x-first release guarantee for all k>0 within the assumed family. It explicitly excludes arbitrary uncontrolled trajectories/rates from evidence and does not extend the successful procedure to every compatible model. Literature descriptions remain marked as inherited/unverified; the mathematical demonstration is the principal contribution.

A corrective assurance must be assessed in the world where the alleged civic impairment occurs, across discovery, proof, decision and delivery. The manuscript separates loss of justificatory weight from automatic policy impermissibility: risk, competing civic access budgets and other reasons still matter. The concrete route shows why mere accessible complaint intake or an independent panel may fail at implementation. It acknowledges the general remedial-design antecedent and locates its claim in democratic justification.

The same third-party false-complaint error yields different residual duties depending on whether the destroyed photos would have provided a cheaper defence. A five-year preservation undertaking fixes the protected function before the result; ordinary authentication is distinguished from reparative funding of added correction costs. Practical entitlement, procedural preclusion and historical evidence are separated. The argument allows warranted probabilistic inferences, privacy limits, proportionality and no duplicate recovery, rather than declaring all remedial decisions non-evidence.
